title: unitframes
summary: GameLoop.UnitFrames.cs draws player and target frames on the mirrored UI-TargetingFrame art with portraits, bars, faction tint, level/difficulty, skull/death state, combat feedback and target auras. UnitFrameUiLaw supplies Benilla's FFA-first PvP badge, target classification border map, and resting/auto-attack/hate-list priority. The player frame now draws the exact state-icon atlas halves, attack disc, additive status ring/glow and 0.5-second 55/255-to-1 triangle pulse; both frame hit rectangles open the current UnitPopup on right click. TextStatusBar.xml is shared hover/pinned-number plumbing for unit, pet, and XP bars rather than a standalone surface; no protected unit-frame geometry is changed by recording it here.

openItems.text: No PVP icons on player/target frames (Benilla's three-branch UpdatePvP law: Alliance/Horde/FFA) and no CMSG_TOGGLE_PVP anywhere (the registry's missing opcode; Benilla exposes it via /pvp)
openItems.resolution: 2026-08-21: Added PLAYER_FLAGS mirroring, CMSG_TOGGLE_PVP and /pvp, UnitFrameUiLaw's exact FFA-first faction badge law, and the exact 64x64 player/target PvP-icon anchors and textures.

openItems.text: No elite/rare/rareelite/worldboss classification border swap on the target frame (Benilla landed CheckClassification)
openItems.resolution: 2026-08-21: UnitFrameUiLaw maps creature-query rank 1/2/3 to UI-TargetingFrame-Elite, rank 4 to UI-TargetingFrame-Rare and all other ranks to the normal border; target rendering swaps only the texture path as current Benilla does.

openItems.text: No rest icon/status glow on the player frame (Program.UnitFrames.cs lines 125-134 self-declare PlayerRestIcon, PlayerStatusGlow, PlayerAttackIcon etc. NOT-DRAWN)
openItems.resolution: 2026-08-21: Mirrored PLAYER_FLAGS_RESTING and added UnitFrameUiLaw status priority/pulse. PlayerFrame draws UI-StateIcon rest/attack cells, their additive glow cells, UI-Player-Status ring and attack background at the current FrameXML seats.

openItems.text: No leader/master-looter icons and no group indicator plate
openItems.resolution: 2026-08-21: Re-triaged against current Benilla UnitFrames.xml, which explicitly lists leader/master/group-indicator regions as OUT and defines none of them. Removed the stale NOT-DRAWN parity classifications; these are no longer a Benilla-parity gap.

openItems.text: No right-click dropdown wired to the player/target frames themselves (the unit popup opens only from party frames and world-click)
openItems.resolution: 2026-08-21: DrawUnitFrameHitRect wires right-click on both player and target frames to OpenUnitPopup at the current FrameXML dropdown seats.
